facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's no-effect assertion by following the destructive inline event test and C short-circuit evaluation order.
facts.value: SpecialLw loop setup clears throw_flags and installs this routine in accessory4_cb. Each invocation tests B3 first through ftCheckThrowB3, consuming a set B3 flag before checking floor contact. A set B3 event without floor contact is therefore consumed without repositioning hitboxes. If B3 was set and floor contact is present, the routine updates all four hitbox positions using floor queries, fighter-position fallback on query failure, and a two-unit upward adjustment. If B3 is clear, no floor query or hitbox update occurs.
